# QUALITY POLICY

L&T Valves Limited is committed to enhance
value to customers by delivering best-in-class
valves and flow-control solutions.

We achieve this by:

- Complying with codes, standards, customer
specifications, statutory and regulatory
requirements as applicable to our products

- Continually improving the effectiveness of
Quality Management System through
appropriate technologies, processes and
total employee involvement

- Communicating, understanding, implementing
and maintaining this Quality Policy at all levels

Date: 10 Jan 2021

S. Kalyana Raman
S KALYANARAMAN
Chief Executive
